title: Changes
description: Drafts, proposals and applied changes to the plant registry: edits, imports, changes of many entries, id changes and assistants’ proposals. Where a site needs a second person, every change is proposed here and someone else applies it.

settings.catalogue: Changes to device profiles and KPI definitions need a second person
settings.catalogueHint: Whoever proposes a change to the catalogue never applies it themselves.

empty.drafts: You have no drafts. Changes you make where a second person is needed, or that you may only propose, are kept in a draft.
empty.closed: No rejected, withdrawn or expired change sets.

bar.label: Your draft
bar.none: Changes here go into a draft first.

history.label: History
history.emptyText: Changes from 0.13 on are kept here, field by field.

entryChanged.title: Changed by someone else
entryChanged.intro: Someone else changed this entry since you opened it. Their changes to fields you did not touch are kept. Choose for each field you both changed.
entryChanged.none: No field was changed on both sides – your change is saved with theirs.

conflict.title: Changed in Steward since
conflict.intro: These fields were changed in Steward after the change was written. Choose for each one; the preview is computed again.

detail.previewReady_other: Preview ready: {{count}} entries, {{conflicts}} conflicts to choose.

blocked.PLANT_CHANGESET_OWN: A second person applies it: you wrote it.
blocked.PLANT_CHANGESET_PROPOSE_FIRST: Changes here need a second person: propose the draft first.
blocked.FORBIDDEN: You may not change everything it touches – someone who manages it applies it.
blocked.PLANT_CHANGESET_DRAFT: A draft is applied by its author.

siteReview.label: Changes need a second person
siteReview.hint: Every change to this site – also yours and imports – is proposed first and applied by someone else who manages the site.

form.draftHint: You may propose changes here: what you save goes into your draft, someone who manages the site applies it.
form.catalogueHint: You may propose changes to device profiles and KPI definitions: what you save goes into your draft, someone who manages the catalogue applies it.
form.savedToDraft: Saved into your draft “{{title}}” – nothing is changed in Steward until it is applied
form.addToDraftHint: Nothing is changed yet: it goes into your draft as one change, previewed again when the draft is reviewed and applied.
form.proposedForReview: Changes here need a second person: proposed for review as “{{title}}”
form.importProposeOnly: You may propose changes: preview the files, then add them to your draft. Someone who manages the sites applies it.

retention.title: Plant registry history
retention.description: Every change to the plant registry keeps a row of history per entry, and every import what it wrote (the baseline its preview compares with). The history of an entry stays while the entry exists; what is older than set here is deleted by the daily clean-up.
retention.removedHistoryDaysHint: Kept after the removal, then deleted ({{min}} to {{max}} days; 1,095 days = 3 years)
retention.closedDaysHint: Rejected, withdrawn and expired change sets; their audit entries stay ({{min}} to {{max}} days)
retention.baselinesPerEntryHint: What the last imports wrote into an entry; the import compares with the last one ({{min}} to {{max}})
retention.usage: What the history takes in the database
retention.usageHint: Rows and their size with indexes, now; the whole database: {{size}}
retention.changeSets: Change sets with their changes and files
retention.saved: Retention of the plant registry history saved
